title: forge
description: PROPOSED under ACP-015. Not normative. A first-party specification the learner builds from. This repository owns the specification and the task pack; it never ships a solution.

track_alignment.description: Track IDs whose required_competencies this specification exercises. At least one; a forge project that teaches nothing on any track does not belong in the catalog.

competencies.description: Catalog competency IDs. References, never scores or levels.

external_services.description: Third-party services the finished system requires. Empty is the preferred value; each entry is a dependency the learner must obtain before starting.

substitutable.description: Whether a local or offline stand-in is acceptable. False means the learner cannot start without it.

problem.description: What is wrong in the world without this system. Stated as a situation, not as a list of features to implement.

users.description: Who runs this and what they are trying to accomplish. At least one, because 'genuinely usable by someone other than the learner' is an entry requirement.

success_criteria.description: Observable properties of the finished system. Each must be checkable by someone who did not write it. These describe the whole project; per-task acceptance criteria live in the task records.

verifiable_by.description: How an outside reviewer confirms this without trusting a claim.

non_goals.description: Explicitly out of scope. Present to bound the work, because an unbounded specification cannot meet its context budget.

operational_requirements.description: What the system must do to be operable, not merely correct. This is what distinguishes a forge project from an exercise and gives production-readiness something real to assess.

failure_modes.description: Failures the system must handle explicitly, each with the required behavior.

rollback.description: How a bad change is undone. 'Not applicable' is not an acceptable value; state the actual procedure.

context_budget.description: Target size of the finished artifact. Advisory and revisable against ACP-016 measurements; stated because an unstated budget is not a constraint.

prerequisites.description: What the learner must already be able to do. Prose, not competency IDs; competency fit is carried by the competencies field.

task_packs.description: Task pack IDs. Non-empty by construction: a forge record with no authored tasks is rejected. This is the rule that stops the forge catalog repeating the breadth-without-depth problem of the upstream project catalog.

sources.description: Where the problem statement came from. Empty is permitted for an invented problem; an entry claims a real need and must be checkable.
